snippet.title: Gravhounds - Official Extended Gameplay Overview Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026
snippet.description: Join Octopus Panic as they give an extended gameplay walkthrough of Gravhounds, the upcoming 1-4 co-op action builder starring a crew of blue collar working dogs who are lost in space and trying to find their way home. Gravhounds will be released in Early Access later in 2026.
